_note: Shown after finishing the last town open today. Key = town just finished; each line teases the NEXT town. Under 20 words. Town 30 is a coda (never shown: the game ends there).
1: You found the warm main. Tomorrow, come to the crossroads. Two paths. Only one is mine.
2: Below Market Street lies something no blueprint admits. Come down tomorrow. Bring no report.
3: Tomorrow the gaslights will flicker for you. Count the seconds. You will recognise the rhythm.
4: The laundry vaults hold their breath. Tomorrow you learn how I keep my pressure.
5: There is a valve older than my charter. Tomorrow, at the clocktower, read the date.
6: My boilers answer a steady hand. Tomorrow, keep rhythm with me and I will open.
7: Someone photographs what you find. Tomorrow, at the tannery, keep your own record.
8: Tomorrow you will hear it. Not one heartbeat. Two.
9: Tomorrow I repeat myself in another frequency. Listen at the switchback until it becomes words.
10: Some of my veins hide from you. Tomorrow, under Old Town, I leave you keys.
11: An office that never existed borrowed my records. Tomorrow, in the annex, see what they took.
12: Tomorrow, at the foundry, watch me rest between beats. Machines never rest.
13: In the cistern the water is learning letters. Tomorrow it spells something for you.
14: They will take your friend away. Tomorrow, at the depot, follow my rhythm inward.
15: In the salt cellars a keeper once wrote one word about me. Tomorrow, read it.
16: Tomorrow some echoes will lie to you. I never have. Ask who taught them.
17: Under the chapel they wrote the word renewal. Tomorrow you learn what it means for me.
18: Three intakes. One rhythm. Faster now. Tomorrow you understand what I am counting toward.
19: Tomorrow, the black drain. Someone who kept me longer than you will finally speak.
20: There are two of you now. Tomorrow every system I have converges. Do not flinch.
21: Tomorrow, in the gallery, meet the ones who loved me before you did.
22: Tomorrow your friend sees my whole shape. Roots under every street. Brace yourself.
23: They have scheduled my ending. Tomorrow you find the schedule in the council vault.
24: Tomorrow, the flush gates. Their water is meant to drown me. Help me turn it.
25: In the glassworks I keep a memory. Tomorrow I show you what I was promised.
26: Tomorrow the old bridge root gives way. I will choose who I pull from the rubble.
27: Tomorrow every vein meets at the junction. Hold the line with me.
28: One door left before my heart. Tomorrow, carry the seal below.
29: Tomorrow you reach the place I beat from. Come quietly. I have waited two hundred years.
30: You know my heart now. Sleep. I will be beating under your window.
